title: Network Engineer – Tier 2 Lan / Wi-Fi

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Develops, modifies, applies, and maintains standards for proposal‐quality operating methods, processes, systems, and procedures across the Grand Prairie organization.

Conducts proposal inspections, testing, verification, and validation to ensure every submission meets customer, contractual, and internal requirements. Implements and continually refines proposal development and execution processes and methods, guaranteeing that all deliverables satisfy acceptable reliability and performance standards.

Defines overall operating criteria to drive the software‐and‐systems quality program in alignment with project, process, and contract objectives.

Ensures that proposal and program control documentation—specifications, checklists, risk assessments, and compliance matrices—are fully compliant with contractual obligations, stakeholder expectations, and regulatory mandates.

Reviews and incorporates applicable specifications, tools, techniques, and methodologies into each proposal package.

Performs or directs verification of proposal requirement allocations, traceability, and testability, guaranteeing that each requirement is explicitly addressed, measurable, and auditable throughout the bid lifecycle.

Basic Required Qualifications:
  • STEM degree at the Bachelor level or above
  • Understanding of the Quality Management System (QMS), Quality Proposals and Quality Engineering

  • Proficient skill level with Microsoft Office applications such as Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal direct supervision

  • Demonstrate ability to use causal analysis tools to analyze and resolve technical / process issues varying from basic to very complex

Desired skills :

  • An understanding of dispositioning non-conforming products
  • Knowledge of Configuration and Data Management
  • Experience in establishing Performance Metrics for identifying process improvement
  • Experience in writing technical and cost volumes
  • Understanding of TINA Compliance and TINA SWEEP
  • Strong knowledge of Industry recognized Quality Systems/Models such as Capability Maturity Model Integrated (CMMI), QMS System Audit (AS9100, ISO9001), AS9145

  • An understanding of the Missiles & Fire Control (MFC) SAP and Procure-to-pay (P2P) business systems

title: Inspector-2nd Shift
description:
Contractor Opportunity: 2nd Shift Cable Inspector

Our company culture values teamwork, integrity, and excellence, and we're dedicated to making a positive impact on our communities and the world.

Job Summary: As a Cable Inspection Specialist, you'll play a critical role in ensuring the quality of our cable products.   • Strong background in cable manufacturing and inspection
  • Experience with soldered and crimp inspection on cables using IPC-A-620 standards
  • Detail-oriented and proficient at interpreting drawings, diagrams, parts lists, IPC manuals, and work instructions
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and interface with assemblers, test technicians, engineers, customers, and management
  • Proficient with Personal Computers and newer applications
  • No degree required
  • Must be able to read and write English
  • Must take and pass a medical screening exam as outlined in the supplier guide

What We Offer:
  • Competitive hourly rate
  • Opportunity to work on exciting projects and contribute to the success of our organization
  • Collaborative and dynamic work environment
  • Professional growth and development opportunities
  • Flexible scheduling with overtime opportunities on weekends

description:

Our organization oversees all aspects of Anti-Tamper and embedded Cybersecurity across Missiles and Fire Control.

What You Will Be Doing:
As the Cyber Systems Security Engineer you will be responsible for providing embedded System Security Engineering design and implementation in all aspects of System Security Engineering (SSE) process in development of Department of Defense (DoD) Weapon Systems.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Assessing and mitigating System Security threats/risks throughout the embedded Weapon System development life cycle
• Validating System Security Engineering requirements decomposition, allocation and analysis for embedded Weapon Systems
• Implementing System Security Engineering solutions hardware and software
• Verifying implementation of system security requirements
• Designing, implementing, deploying, and maintaining state of the art System Security architectures and countermeasures to protect and enable innovative new Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control products
• Analyzing weaknesses, vulnerabilities and threats against System Security posture on product designs
• Prototyping and testing System Security countermeasures that defend against cyber-attacks against Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control Weapon System products

Required Experience:
